region_scene_page.compact: Alt-country emerged from bands and writers who loved country and folk traditions but carried indie-rock habits, rougher guitars, and anti-commercial posture.
region_scene_page.standard: Alt-country emerged from bands and writers who loved country and folk traditions but carried indie-rock habits, rougher guitars, and anti-commercial posture. region_scene_page.deep: Alt-country emerged from bands and writers who loved country and folk traditions but carried indie-rock habits, rougher guitars, and anti-commercial posture. The twang sounds deliberately scuffed, with rock-band edges and songwriter melancholy in the foreground. Wilco with Billy Bragg's California Stars, Wilco's Being There, Ryan Adams, and Uncle Tupelo's Gun give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
